name: Dreamdata
description: Connect Claude to Dreamdata to build and run Analytics Hub reports, analyze customer journeys, and query audiences.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Dreamdata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Dreamdata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dreamdata.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Dreamdata MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dreamdata lists 24 MCP tools, including describe_audience_config_schema, get_audience_definition, get_company_journey, list_audience_filter_properties, list_audience_filter_values, list_audiences, list_company_journey_stages, list_my_accounts, list_report_metric_drilldown_entities, list_saved_reports, report_builder_get_components, and report_builder_list_analysis_types.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Dreamdata?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Dreamdata in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Dreamdata requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Dreamdata is developed by Dreamdata.io ApS. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
